acceptanceCriteria: README in English Chinese and Japanese leads with the adopter problem and explains declared scope verification evidence and human decisions.
The default installation path uses a real published v1.0.0 asset with verified filename manifest checksum and copyable commands.
The v1.0.1-rc.1 macOS arm64 build is labeled optional prerelease and formal Runtime acceptance is disclosed as incomplete.
v0.2.94-specific commands are absent from the main installation path and retained only in a clearly labeled maintainer history section without changing historical evidence.
The README removes the internal WI-663 record as the primary adopter example and makes no unverified behavioral or performance claims.
All links commands release assets and localized version boundaries are checked against the same sources.
goal: A first-time adopter can understand the product boundary, verify and install a published v1.0.0 artifact, run an honest first CLI example, and distinguish stable v1.0.0 from the optional macOS arm64 v1.0.1-rc.1 prerelease.
intent: Improve AI Cockpit's public repository entry and stable v1.0.0 installation path.
outOfScope: Application or Runtime code; Runtime or MCP behavior; tests or build files; GitHub About metadata; CONTRIBUTING; demo or screenshot capture; marketing or funding submissions; release publication or tags; historical .ai evidence or archive bytes; any path outside the six declared documentation files
